pipeline.description: Classifies the issue as bug, feature, chore, or spike. Validates required fields (problem statement, acceptance criteria). Rejects malformed issues with a corrective comment.

Drafts a Product Requirements Document for an appropriately-sized issue. Rewrites the issue body with the PRD in user-story + Gherkin format and waits for stakeholder approval at the 01_product_docs/prd-writer:approved gate. Set-blocks oversized issues with a decomposition note rather than drafting a sprawling PRD.

Scripted step: creates the shared issue branch (issue-{N}) and opens a draft PR with 'Closes #{N}' in the body, establishing the GitHub Development sidebar link. Applies source-issue:{N} label via link-pr-to-issue.sh. All subsequent agent commits (docs, code) accumulate in this PR. Idempotent — exits cleanly if branch and PR already exist. Deterministic; does not invoke Claude CLI.

Cross-checks the approved PRD against existing product documentation in docs/product/. If any docs need updating, writes the changes to the shared issue branch — the draft PR was already opened by the create-pr step, so commits accumulate there. Posts a summary comment. Gates on prd-docs-updater:approved before the build agent starts.

Implements a GitHub issue and its sub-issues as a defensive programmer. Reads the approved PRD, docs/tech-spec/, and each sub-issue in order. Writes files only — commits to the shared issue branch. The draft PR was opened by the create-pr step and stays as draft until pr-reviewer promotes it to ready on APPROVE. Triggered automatically when the docs-update gate is approved.

Ad-hoc PR reviewer. Reads the PR diff and linked issue spec, then posts a structured review covering correctness, design alignment, standards compliance, and security. Concludes with an explicit APPROVE or REQUEST CHANGES recommendation. On APPROVE (complete), the orchestrator marks the draft PR ready for merge. Triggered by 05_execute/pr-reviewer:requested. Gates on 05_execute/pr-reviewer:approved.

Ad-hoc three-persona codebase review (Defensive Programmer, Security Analyst, Quality Assurance). Reads the full codebase and creates a 'Technical Review - {date}' GitHub issue containing all findings with severity ratings and AI-actionable remediation instructions. Triggered by applying the 09_gap_assessment/codebase-reviewer:requested label to any issue. Cross-references docs/product/ only when code intent is unclear.
